Version 1 · applies from PawPoller 4.58.0

1. Who and what

These terms are between you and the PawPoller Project ("we"). They cover the PawPoller app, the website pawpoller.com, the official downloads, and the optional services we run for PawPoller users: update checks, check-ins, error reports and the Instagram picture relay. By using any of them, you agree to these terms. If you don't agree, please don't use them.

2. The software is open source

PawPoller's code is released under the GNU Affero General Public License, version 3 (AGPL-3.0), which says what you can do with the code itself: use it, study it, change it and share it. If you run a changed copy for other people over a network, the AGPL asks you to offer them its source code. Versions released before 4.55.0 are under the MIT licence. Nothing in these terms takes away the rights those licences give you; these terms add the rules for our website and services, and for using PawPoller with other people's sites.

3. Your accounts on other sites are your responsibility

PawPoller posts and reads on sites like FurAffinity, DeviantArt, Bluesky and others on your behalf, using your own logins or keys.

  • You must follow each site's own rules, including any limits on automated tools and its minimum age.
  • Some connections use a site's unofficial or app-only access (for example Pixiv and FurryNetwork). A site can change or block this at any time, and some sites don't allow automated access at all.
  • If a site limits, suspends or bans your account, or removes your work, that's between you and the site. We can't be responsible for another site's decisions.
  • Keep your logins safe. PawPoller stores them encrypted on your own machine, but you choose where it runs and who can reach it.

4. Your content stays yours

Your art, stories and posts belong to you. We claim no rights over them. They stay on your machine except where you send them: to the sites you post to, and, only if you switch it on, briefly through the Instagram relay. You must only post what you have the right to post.

5. Adult content and age

  • PawPoller can be used by anyone for safe-for-work work.
  • Adult and mature features are for people 18 and over. When you set up PawPoller it asks whether you're 18 or older; if you say you're under 18, Mature and Adult ratings, adults-only sites and turning safe mode off are locked.
  • Telling the app you're 18 or over when you aren't breaks these terms.
  • You're responsible for rating your work correctly. Each site's own age limits apply on that site too; PawPoller lists them in Settings → General.

6. The Instagram picture relay

If you switch the relay on, our server holds the picture you're posting at an unguessable link for 15 minutes so Instagram can fetch it, then deletes it. Using it, you agree:

  • to send only pictures and videos you have the right to post, that Instagram's own rules allow;
  • never to send anything illegal;
  • not to use it for anything except posting to Instagram through PawPoller.

We may refuse, limit or switch off the relay at any time, including for anyone who misuses it. To report something on it, write to security@pawpoller.com.

7. Our services can change

The website, downloads, update checks, check-ins, error reports and the relay are offered as they are, for free, and may change, pause or stop. We'll try to give notice of anything that affects you.

8. Liability, and your consumer rights

  • PawPoller is free software, provided as it is. We work hard to make it reliable, but we can't promise it will never fail, never lose a post, or always work with every site.
  • Nothing in these terms removes rights you have under the Australian Consumer Law or other consumer protection laws that can't be excluded.
  • As far as the law allows, we're not liable for indirect losses, such as lost income or a lost account on another site, and our total liability is limited to the amount you paid us for the service in question. Everything we currently offer is free.

9. Ending things

You can stop using PawPoller at any time: uninstall it and delete its data folder. We may stop offering our services to anyone who breaks these terms.

10. Law

These terms are governed by the laws of New South Wales, Australia, and its courts can hear any dispute. If you live somewhere whose laws give you rights that can't be excluded, those still apply.

11. Changes to these terms

We'll date every change here, and big ones will also show in the app's "What's new". Using PawPoller after a change means accepting the new version.
